pairs.subject: windowed-inference-over-oversized-inputs
pairs.evidence: src/features/schedules/libs/calendarHelpers.ts:193 The only 'windows' in this context are time windows: a 5-minute conflict window and a 90s slot-to-run tolerance used to group and match cron fires on a calendar. No model runs anywhere in it, so nothing is stitched over an oversized input. A grep of src/features/schedules/ for stitch, blend, inference, tensor and accelerator found no matches; 'overlap' only matches calendar conflict-overlap UI.

techniques.evidence: src/features/schedules/libs/calendarHelpers.ts:223 Overlapping windows here are merged into conflict ranges for badge counts. No predictions are blended into a canvas.
src/features/schedules/libs/calendarHelpers.ts:300 This is a matching tolerance, not a taper weight. There are no blend weights or normaliser division.
